scientific_name: Historical Fusion Score-Shape Conditional-Binomial Goal-Difference Tilt

objective.primary: carry the frozen V3.2.4 H/A boundary repair into the V3.1.1 225-cell matrix using a football-generative conditional goal-allocation tilt while preserving every total-goals marginal and every draw-diagonal cell

independent_scientific_rationale.principle: conditional on a fixed total-goal count T, a relative-strength change is represented as an exponential tilt of the home-goal allocation odds; the natural sufficient statistic is signed goal difference h-a, not score-cell identity and not a previously failed diagnostic metric
independent_scientific_rationale.relation_to_conditional_binomial: for fixed T, h-a=2h-T, so exp(lambda*(h-a)/2) is equivalent up to a T-only normalizer to a log-odds shift in the conditional home-goal allocation

frozen_target_hda.required_property: target draw probability must equal frozen V3.1.1 draw probability within 5e-12; otherwise fail closed

transport.closed_form_family: for each fixed total T, keep the diagonal cell fixed; for every asymmetric cell (h,a), set q[h,a] proportional to base[h,a]*exp(lambda*(h-a)/2) with one T-specific normalizer preserving that T's asymmetric mass
transport.global_constraint: one deterministic lambda is solved so integrated HOME probability equals frozen V3.2.4 target; DRAW is fixed and AWAY follows by normalization
transport.objective_interpretation: natural exponential-family projection along the conditional home-goal-allocation sufficient statistic h-a
transport.lambda_solver: deterministic bisection on [-64,64], tolerance 1e-14, max_iterations 256; numerical constants only
structural_consequences: every total-goals T marginal is unchanged
all diagonal draw cells are unchanged
within a fixed T the asymmetric score allocation changes smoothly according to signed goal difference
no cell-specific multiplier or score-specific exception exists

program_terminal_rule.future_reopening_requires: explicit user redefinition of Stage6 acceptance semantics or a genuinely new pre-match information/generative axis, not another post-view transport variant

forbidden: manual match team league fold or score exceptions
adding protection targeted to any previously observed failing metric
fourth transport-family search under the same Stage6 program after this family fails
